slides.title: Our Purpose We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that uses simple math, writing, and reading aloud exercises as an intervention to improve cognitive function.
slides.text:
Our Purpose
We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that uses simple math, writing, and reading aloud exercises as an intervention to improve cognitive function.

slides.title: About  Us
slides.text:
About 
Us
BEI is an international organization established at Universities in 4 countries
Program is 100% free to participate in
Sessions led entirely by university student volunteers
We currently have 80 Chapters, over 1,000 incredible volunteers, and are continuing to rapidly grow!

slides.title: The Research Research conducted by Japanese Neuroscientist Dr. Ryuta Kawashima
slides.text:
The Research
Research conducted by Japanese Neuroscientist Dr. Ryuta Kawashima
Did simple math, reading, and writing 
30 minutes a day, 5 days a week
Showed improvements in cognitive functioning for Alzheimer’s
E
xercises activate the prefrontal cortex 
part of brain responsible for memory, planning, and cognition
Individuals showed progress in communication skills
Reported feeling happier overall
https://www.tohoku.ac.jp/en/research/research_highlights/research_highlight_22.html  and 
https://academic.oup.com/biomedgerontology/article/60/3/380/630607.

slides.title: What We Do Work with both Dementia and non-Dementia residents
slides.text:
What We Do
Work with both Dementia and non-Dementia residents
Lead seniors in brain exercises consisting of 
writing, math, and reading
Work with participants for 30 minute - 45 minutes multiple times a week (virtually or in-person if possible)

slides.title: What are the Benefits of BEI for students? Learn more about yourself and grow as a person!
slides.text:
What are the Benefits of BEI for students?
Learn more about yourself and grow as a person! 
Do you enjoy people-oriented jobs/opportunities? Do you enjoy working with elderly individuals? Do you flourish in leadership and teaching positions?
Earn invaluable volunteer experience
Can help with applying for Graduate School, Medical School, Job opportunities, etc.
BEI sessions count as volunteer hours for Honors                Program
